visual_requirements.description: One unified equally vertically divided form: anatomical right half male Shiva (viewer-left), anatomical left half female Parvati (viewer-right), not two adjacent people or two heads.
No sourced physical power manifestation; sacred grandeur through unity, active stance and editorial devotional scale only.
Editorial abstract sacred architecture, no researched specific location asserted; the united deity dominates.

A.prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration. Imposing undeniable main subject, high-contrast low-key dark walnut/antique gold palette, textured brushwork and physically tactile surfaces, legible silhouette at 200 pixels. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, pseudo-script, logo, watermark, signature, border or frame; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glowing aura, neon lines, energy ribbons, floating runes, or unsupported anatomy.
ANATOMY: ARDHANARISVARA, ONE unified human-form Hindu deity Shiva united with Parvati, split EQUALLY DOWN A VERTICAL CENTERLINE from crown of head through face, neck, torso and garment. ONE HEAD not two faces. Subject's RIGHT HALF is MALE SHIVA and appears on VIEWER'S LEFT; subject's LEFT HALF is FEMALE PARVATI and appears on VIEWER'S RIGHT. Viewer-left brow/jaw angular masculine, viewer-right brow/jaw softer feminine, exactly one eye each side and one central nose/mouth, unified seamless natural face, not sewn or grotesque. Two human arms and two legs as restrained editorial default; no unsupported extra arms, third eye, crescent, snakes, trident, other weapons, horns or magic ornaments. Both halves FULLY OPAQUELY DRESSED: masculine viewer-left dark gold heavy wrap covers shoulder/torso, feminine viewer-right crimson-gold sari covers shoulder/chest/torso, central division clear without bare chest. [ardhanarisvara-c01/c02/c04/c07] MOMENT: Lean forward in a solemn sovereign movement, both arms extend open slightly toward low viewer while their hands remain low at edges; face looks directly down with overwhelming divine assurance. No decorative standing mannequin. POWER: no documented physical visible power; synthesis of masculine/feminine principles is expressed by visibly equal body halves, no magical beams or aura. [ardhanarisvara-c03] SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low confronting close portrait, face and upper body fill 90 percent, complete unified head and vertical split unmistakable even at thumbnail; keep face frontal enough that both halves equally visible, do not turn away. LIGHT & WEATHER: one gold backlight through high architectural gap, deep shadows preserve both face sides visible; not a circular halo. SURFACE: textured opaque woven cloth, detailed natural face, carved ancient stone peripheral. SETTING: editorial abstract sacred threshold, no claimed historical location. MOOD: respectful awe-inspiring living Hindu religion, not horror or ordinary split-costume actress/man.

ONE head with one centered nose and mouth, ONE eye on each side; right male face/body contour on viewer-left clearly angular and robust, left female on viewer-right clearly soft and graceful.
